0. Today

What the player sees now: Freedoom's bar, numbers and face. The 3D view is MAP01 from the 2026-10-13 smoke screenshot; every mock below is drawn with the same positions as GZDoom's DoomStatusBar.DrawMainBar (g4.14.2).

Freedoom today, MAP01 start, 3x

1. The status bar (STBAR 320x32 + STARMS 38x32)

Three options, each in English and Russian. Numbers: the recommended N2; face: the recommended A. Start numbers are the real MAP01 spawn (TT-33, 50 rounds of SD_START_CLIP, 100 %, 0 % armour, slot 2 lit; maxima 200/50/50/300 as in the smoke screenshot). The mid-fight state is illustrative: 34 % health (pain level 3, face turned right), 47 % armour, PPSh and IZh found, the blue pass held (the key icon is whatever is installed in assets/graphics/hud/, read only).

recommended

4BO green plate (the doors' and crates' green), one raised riveted panel per section, recessed black-green wells, labels stencilled in cream like the crate numbers. Reads as military hardware; quiet enough that the red numbers and the face lead.

2. The face: three headgear options (straight, STFST01)

Sergeant Ramon Vilanova (D14): Barcelona-born, olive-tan skin, thick dark brows, dark eyes, strong nose, square stubbled jaw. Each drawn at exactly the Freedoom lump's size and offsets.

recommended

Face A: Ushanka, flaps down

Grey fur ushanka with the red-star cockade; the flaps frame the face and hide the ears, which is what makes the silhouette read as 'Soviet soldier' at 24 px. MAP01 is the Urals in November 1977 (LORE): it is the season's hat.

5. Assessment, Plan B and install

The honest assessment of the face. The method (shaded height field 8x supersampled, crisp eyes/brows/mouth stamped at 1x) reaches a readable, consistent face that turns, bleeds and grins in all 42 frames from one definition, and it reproduces byte for byte. It does NOT reach the painted likeness of Doom's or Freedoom's face (those are digitised from a sculpt and hand-retouched): ours reads as a soldier in a hat with a stubbled face, not yet as a specific man. If the CEO wants a portrait with character, Plan B is the D79 route: the CEO generates a face sheet in Gemini on magenta, and the frames are cut, scaled to these exact boxes and palette-snapped (the same pipeline as tools/art/gemini_frames.py). The prompt, ready to paste: 
Pixel-art sprite sheet, a 5 x 8 grid of portraits of the same man on a flat pure magenta background (#FF00FF), no gaps, no text, no borders. Each cell is a head-and-shoulders portrait in the style of the 1993 DOOM status-bar face: front-lit, painted, 24 x 29 pixel look, chunky pixels, limited palette. The man: a Soviet Spetsnaz sergeant in 1977, Spanish (Catalan) by birth, about 46 years old, olive-tan skin, short black hair, thick dark eyebrows, dark brown eyes, a straight strong nose, square jaw, dark three-day stubble, no moustache. He wears a grey fur ushanka with the ear flaps DOWN and a small red star cockade on the front, and a khaki gymnastyorka collar. Rows = health from top to bottom: 1 unhurt, 2 a bruise on the cheekbone and a cut eyebrow, 3 bleeding nose and forehead cut, 4 one eye swollen, blood running over the face, 5 face covered in blood, near collapse. Columns, the same in every row: 1 looking straight, eyes left; 2 looking straight, eyes centre; 3 looking straight, eyes right; 4 head turned 20 degrees to the viewer's right; 5 head turned 20 degrees to the viewer's left; 6 shocked, eyes wide, mouth open in a shout; 7 evil grin showing teeth, eyes narrowed; 8 furious, teeth clenched, brows down. Same head size and position in every cell, head fills the cell, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing against the magenta. Second image, same style and man: two cells, A golden glowing eyes with a faint smirk (invulnerable), B dead: eyes closed, head slumped, face bloodied.
Install notes (mod-engineer, after approval).
  1. English: graphics/STBAR.png, STARMS.png, the 42 STF*, STTNUM0-9, STTMINUS, STTPRCNT, STYSNUM0-9, STGNUM0-9 replace Freedoom's by name. Faces and STTMINUS carry grAb offsets equal to Freedoom's.
  2. Russian: the localized-texture swap is commented out in g4.14.2 (ADR 010), so localized/textures/STBAR.ru.png alone would never be drawn. Route: SD_StatusBar overrides DrawMainBar (or only the two DrawImage calls of STBAR/STARMS) to take the picture names from LANGUAGE ids, as DrawPaused already does for the pause sign. That copies engine code (debt like T14). Bar B-BI avoids it entirely.
  3. Palette v2 (mosaic_cobalt for face C, flesh_pink/rust in the skin): check_pk3.py's PALETTE_V2_LUMPS and tests/test_palette_v2.py's APPROVED_IN_V2 must list them.
  4. LICENSES.md: one row (our generator, seed list in this module), no foreign pixels. Engine pass pending (D26).
Proposals only; output in work/art/hud/. Sizes and offsets equal the Freedoom 0.13.0 lumps (tests/test_gen_hud.py).
